decisions.reason: Although it was no longer prominently observed after launch, this illuminated candle-arch line remains close to the firm's handcrafted core and is cheap enough to keep as a niche option.
This one-tier Christmas pyramid sits squarely in the firm's established seasonal craft business, so retaining it preserves upside with limited additional commitment.

After several seasons without visible continuation, the electronic music box appears to have yielded enough evidence of weak fit with the firm's traditional artisanal positioning to justify abandonment.
As an accessory whose value depends on the electronic music box, this platform loses most of its option value once the main electronic concept no longer looks promising.
This seasonal add-on is peripheral, dependent on the same weak electronic line, and no longer merits keeping resources tied up in a low-prospect option.
